import Mathlib

theorem Opn.h2_test : ∀ S : Finset ℕ, ∑ a ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ a - 1) ≠ 1 / 2 := by
  have key : ∀ S : Finset ℕ, ∃ p q : ℕ, Odd q ∧ ∑ a ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ a - 1) = (p : ℝ) / q := by
    intro S
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨0, 1, odd_one, by simp⟩
    | insert a S ha ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, q, hq, hs⟩ := ih
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, hs]
      by_cases h0 : a = 0
      · subst h0
        exact ⟨p, q, hq, by simp⟩
      · have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h0
        have hd : Odd (2 ^ a - 1) :=
          Nat.Even.sub_odd Nat.one_le_two_pow (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, h0⟩) odd_one
        have hdc : ((2 ^ a - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 ^ a - 1 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub Nat.one_le_two_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one]
        have hqne : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hq.pos.ne'
        have hdne : ((2 ^ a - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.pos.ne'
        refine ⟨q + p * (2 ^ a - 1), q * (2 ^ a - 1), hq.mul hd, ?_⟩
        rw [← hdc]
        push_cast
        field_simp
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq, hs⟩ := key S
  rw [hs] at hS
  have hqne : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hq.pos.ne'
  have h2 : (q : ℝ) = 2 * p := by
    field_simp at hS
    linarith
  have h3 : q = 2 * p := by exact_mod_cast h2
  exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hq) ⟨p, by omega⟩
